description: This file contains unit tests for the FormValidator class in the OpenMRS project. It uses JUnit 5 to test various validation scenarios for the Form class, including validation of null or invalid fields and field length constraints.

classes.name: FormValidatorTest
classes.description: A JUnit test class testing the validation logic of FormValidator.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailValidationIfNameIsNull
methods.description: Tests that validation fails when the Form's name is null.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailValidationIfVersionIsNull
methods.description: Tests that validation fails when the Form's version is null.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailValidationIfVersionDoesNotMatchRegex
methods.description: Tests that validation fails when the Form's version does not match the required regex.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailValidationIfRetiredReasonIsNull
methods.description: Tests that validation fails when the Form is marked as retired but lacks a retire reason.

methods.name: validate_shouldPassValidationIfAllFieldsAreCorrect
methods.description: Tests that validation passes when all required fields are correctly set.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailValidationIfRetiredReasonIsEmpty
methods.description: Tests that validation fails when retired is true but retire reason is empty.

methods.name: validate_shouldPassValidationIfFieldLengthsAreCorrect
methods.description: Tests that validation passes when all string fields are within allowed length.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailValidationIfFieldLengthsAreNotCorrect
methods.description: Tests that validation fails when string fields exceed maximum allowed length.
